registration: Before V6 training, rule selection or outcome evaluation
objective: Identify turnover drag via independent rule additions/removals, select only with past validation, retrain stock models, compare net returns with frozenV4latched and matched momentum.

data.source: FrozenV5 bundle ending2026-11-18; all prices,57features and legal5session labels unchanged
data.known_cash_dates: New copy adds four already source-verified dividend pay dates from V4/V5 supplements, conservatively available next trading open; retain declared date and PDF hash.
data.limitations: 594 currently selected/surviving securities; historical universe/ST/industry not fully point-in-time. No new future data or contest assumptions.

risk.controller: Exact frozenV4 latched state:90%normal,45%after4%DD,20%after6%DD with no new buys,0%after8%terminal. Same market regime,original highwater never resets. NoV5voloverlay/recovery.
risk.execution: V4 engine:5session rebalance,integercents/lots,T+1,limit/gap/liquiditychecks,1%priorADV,14%name28%sector targets and15%/30%postbuyhardcaps. Infeasible turnover constraints reduce only; never block terminal risk exit.
risk.costs: SameV4fees,minimumfees,taxes/reserve and10/20/30bp per-side slippage. Ending holdings marked at close, not forced liquidated.

rules.design: 16 configurations:baseline/alloff;7singleadditions;all7on;7single-removals. Two conditional contrasts per rule, not a full128factorial. Do not assign one universal effect when interactions differ.
rules.baseline: ExactV4allocation math and rank12retention, unlimited cost-justified replacement,normal50%budget,no caution budget,no extra penalty/deadband.
rules.normal_budget25: Only normal-state budget50->25%; initial empty account exempt.
rules.caution_budget25: Only level1 receives25%buy/sell budget; distinct from normal budget.
rules.replace1_vs_gap: One discretionary replacement and3percentage-point ranking gap are separate toggles. Required exits/vacancyfills not counted as discretionary substitutions.
rules.penalty10: Additional10bp per buy/sell traded weight in optimization, not an added fictitious realized fee. Existing marketcosts already in model.
rules.deadband2: Keep prior weight when target difference<=2pp and all portfolio limits remain feasible.

training.models: SameindustryresidualRidge(alpha1000) andHGB7leaves100iterations asV5, retrain all48models from scratch; same5momentum/blend candidates.
training.stage1: Using momentum validation forecasts, evaluate all16rules on sixcomplete10session accounts+partialtail AND continuous63session account. Choose turnover config before evaluating stock overlay.
training.rule_adoption: Fallback baseline. Requiremeanpaired10session net advantage>=10bp,>=4/6wins,one-sided90%two-episodeblockbootstraplower>0;episodeandcontinuousDD<=8% and no more50bp worse thanbaseline;continuousreturn>=baseline-.005;clearaccountinganddata. Maximize meanadvantage-standarderror, ties favor fewer rules thenconfigID.
training.stage2: With chosenconfigfixed, evaluate5stockrankings on samevalidationaccounts. Learnedblend requiresV5industrygate plus20bpnetadvantage,4/6wins,90%lower>0,DD/noqualityflags,andcontinuousnotmore50bpworse. Else momentum.
training.selection_inference: Innerbootstrap is regularization, not formal significance over16searchedconfigs. All trials persisted; no post-outer parameter changes.
training.adaptive_rule_schedule: Chosenconfig assigned to each outer signaldate; affects nextscheduled/risk-triggered rebalance, never retroactive fills or a reset of account risk.

evaluation.uncertainty: Fourpaired98.75%two-sidedcircular2episodeblockCI,5000draws,seed20261119; report additional rule contrasts descriptively with no winning-rule significance claim.
evaluation.reference_parity: Compare baseline V6 momentum forecasts/trades/NAV to frozenV4momentumlatched on exactdates. If added verifiedcashdates or numerical ties cause differences, disclose them rather than quietly relabel reference.
